description_en: Uploads a China National Cryptographic Algorithm (SM) certificate for a domain that is added to WAF in CNAME mode
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi create-sm2-cert --cert-name test-sm2 --encrypt-certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_000_-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --encrypt-private-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----_000_-----END_PRIVATE_KEY----- --sign-certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----_000_-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --sign-private-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----_000_-----END_PRIVATE_KEY----- --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
